figurative_meaning_en: To present truth as falsehood or to distort facts
similar_in_english: To turn the tables on truth
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে তার অপরাধকে ঢাকতে দিনকে রাত করে দিল।
রাজনীতিতে প্রায়ই দিনকে রাত করা হয় সত্যকে লুকাতে।
example_sentences_in_english: He turned day into night to cover up his crime by lying about the facts.
In politics, they often turn day into night to hide the truth from the public.
note: Antonym idiom: রাতকে দিন করা (turning falsehood into truth)
